notes: 4.3.3: problem reports now also tell when the app was closed by a crash in the system's image or video code, or stopped responding, so these can be found and fixed (Android 11 and newer, only with automatic reports on). Everything of 4.3.2 stays: Full HD and HD channels on the TV's own video decoder, movies, series and the guide without freezing the screen, movies that go on after a short internet drop. Your playlists and favourites stay.
notes_en: 4.3.3: problem reports now also tell when the app was closed by a crash in the system's image or video code, or stopped responding, so these can be found and fixed (Android 11 and newer, only with automatic reports on). Everything of 4.3.2 stays: Full HD and HD channels on the TV's own video decoder, movies, series and the guide without freezing the screen, movies that go on after a short internet drop. notes_sq: 4.3.3: raportet e problemeve tash tregojnë edhe kur aplikacioni u mbyll nga një crash në kodin e sistemit për foto ose video, ose kur nuk u përgjigj, që këto të gjenden dhe të rregullohen (Android 11 e më i ri, vetëm me raportet automatike të ndezura). Gjithçka e 4.3.2 mbetet: kanalet Full HD dhe HD te dekoderi i TV-së, filmat, serialet dhe guida pa e ngrirë ekranin, filmat që vazhdojnë pas një ndërprerjeje të shkurtër të internetit. Playlist-at dhe favoritet e tua mbeten.
